class: A wrong answer the agent itself gave was never looked at again, and the owner was asked to fix it
symptom: Meta, 30 September: after f083 the run waiting at hand-over still showed Female; the owner was told to click Male himself -- the agent's mistake handed to the owner.
site: Every portal (self-identification: gender, race, veteran, disability)
root_cause: correct_from_profile put right residence answers, the legal sponsorship/authorization answers and the AI's reported mismatches -- not self-identification. A self-identification choice that differs from the profile, set by the agent or the site, stayed.
why_tests_missed: Self-identification was tested for being answered, never for being put right once wrong.
fix: correct_from_profile also looks at every checked radio of a self-identification question: when the profile states the answer and the checked choice is not it, the choice is put right under safety.may_overrule -- never a choice the owner made while the agent waited (the observer tells which).
prevention: Every answer the profile states is re-checked on every read of the page, and the agent puts right its own mistakes; the owner is told only what is truly theirs.
